About the Company
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.
About The Team
At Careem, the mission for the NextGen Programme is to help grow our engineers by learning how to write Clean Code, use SOLID principle techniques, and design reliable systems. The ultimate goal is to train new engineers to build excellent foundations with high standards. Our Programme covers vast areas in engineering: Backend, Frontend, Web, Mobile, Data Analysis, MLOps, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and QA.
We are looking for software engineers to join our team of talented engineers that share a common interest in distributed backend systems, their scalability, and continued development. You will work alongside a top talent for an accelerated learning path. You will have access to some of the most exciting projects and advanced tech for accelerated learning and exposure.
You will be responsible for maintaining some of our services that power the Careem. Engine, scaling highly distributed systems, and continuously documenting and improving our engineering practices. These large-scale, distributed systems handle everything from user requests to payment processing.
What You'll Do
Our tech stack is Java 8 and Spring Boot, Micro-Service Architecture, SQL and no-SQL DBs and AWS infrastructure. Key responsibilities include:
Development of our distributed backend system to meet the challenging functional, scalability, and reliability requirements for our fast-growing business.
Maintain features and systems, with an emphasis on code quality, maintainability, readability, and testing.
Facilitate collaboration with other engineers, product owners, and designers to solve interesting and challenging problems across our platform.
Be a valued member of an autonomous, cross-functional agile team.
You care about quality and you know what it means to ship high-quality code.
What You'll Need
2-4 Years of Experience required.
The ideal candidate will have a passionate commitment to improving the lives of people, an insane focus on excellence and customer service, and a strong alignment with our core values: being bold, focused, agile and collaborative.
Must Have
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or other related technical fields.
Understanding of Object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms.
Ability to solve complex problems.
Must be able to write clean and maintainable code (must love coding!).
Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions; deal with loosely defined problems and fast-changing requirements & think abstractly.
Passionate about learning new technologies and working on a product of massive scale and impact.
Able to communicate effectively.
Attention to detail.
Nice To Have
Knowledge of AWS
Knowledge of clean code principles
Deep understanding of design patterns
Demonstrated ability of test-driven development

Job Description
We are seeking a technically strong Distributed Cache & Java Support Engineer to support distributed caching solutions and onboard Java and Spring Boot application use cases to the distributed-cache platform.
The candidate will combine hands-on Java development with practical enterprise distributed cache or in-memory data grid experience.
The role focuses on cache use-case assessment and onboarding, Java integration support, distributed-cache troubleshooting, and JVM diagnostics.
Key Responsibilities
Provide production support for distributed cache clusters and related Java application integrations
Monitor cluster health, partition distribution, memory, latency, throughput, capacity, and performance
Support cache configuration and troubleshooting across distributed maps, Near Cache, eviction and expiry/TTL, partitioning, backup and replication, serialization, and cluster discovery
Diagnose cache-related incidents including high latency, memory pressure, member restarts, split-brain conditions, data inconsistency, and degraded performance
Coordinate with application, infrastructure, and vendor support teams to investigate issues and drive technical resolution
Review and modify Java or Spring Boot code required to onboard application use cases to the distributed-cache platform
Work with application teams to understand the use case, data model, access pattern, expected load, and caching objectives
Implement application-side cache integration changes and validate serialization, distributed maps, Near Cache, eviction/TTL, and client configuration
Troubleshoot JVM and application issues encountered during onboarding, integration testing, and production stabilization
Minimum Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology
7+ years of relevant experience in Java backend development, Java application support, distributed systems, or closely related engineering work
3+ years of hands-on experience with distributed caching or in-memory data grid technologies in conjunction with Java applications
Must Have
Strong hands-on Java development experience, including the ability to write and modify Java code
Strong JVM troubleshooting capability, including memory management, garbage collection, thread dumps, heap analysis, and performance diagnosis
Hands-on Spring Boot development or application-support experience, including cache integration or use-case onboarding
Hands-on experience with any distributed caching or in-memory data grid technology such as Redis, Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Ehcache, Oracle Coherence, Infinispan, Memcached, or comparable platforms. Training will be provided on the selected platform.
Strong understanding of distributed maps, Near Cache, eviction/expiry/TTL, partitioning, backup/replication, split-brain, serialization, and cluster discovery
Good to Have
Production application support experience in banking, telecom, or other mission-critical environments, including incident triage, root cause analysis, and documentation
Basic support-level exposure to Kubernetes, containers, Linux, networking, and optionally Anthos or OpenShift; deep platform expertise is not required
Familiarity with CI/CD processes and deployment-pipeline troubleshooting
Experience with Splunk, AppDynamics, or Hazel cast Management Center, plus basic TLS/mTLS and certificate troubleshooting.

Position: Freelance Computer Programmer – Code Review & System Optimization
Department: Information Technology
Project: DT Brain
Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based
Reporting To: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Company: Dany Tameerat
Job Overview
Dany Tameerat is seeking a skilled and experienced Freelance Computer Programmer to conduct a comprehensive technical review, optimization, and enhancement of DT Brain, the company's integrated business management system.
DT Brain supports multiple business functions, including Sales CRM, Finance, Human Resources, Payroll, Project Management, Recruitment, and Executive Reporting.
The ideal candidate will possess strong programming expertise, with proven experience in reviewing existing codebases, identifying technical gaps, resolving performance and security issues, and implementing sustainable improvements to enhance overall system efficiency, reliability, and maintainability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Code Review & Technical Assessment
Conduct a comprehensive review of the existing application codebase.
Identify technical deficiencies, vulnerabilities, inefficiencies, and areas requiring improvement.
Provide a prioritized assessment of recommended fixes and upgrades.
2. System Performance & Optimization
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across application pages, database queries, and background processes.
Optimize database queries, indexing, and overall application responsiveness.
Improve system efficiency without disrupting existing business operations.
3. Application Security & Reliability
Assess authentication mechanisms, role-based access controls, data handling, and software dependencies.
Identify and address potential security vulnerabilities in accordance with established web application security practices.
Strengthen system stability, reliability, and data protection.
4. Code Quality & System Enhancement
Refactor and restructure existing code to improve readability, scalability, and maintainability.
Implement necessary technical upgrades while preserving existing system functionality.
Recommend improvements aligned with long-term system requirements.
5. Testing & Quality Assurance
Review existing automated test coverage and ensure current test suites remain functional.
Develop additional tests where necessary to validate system improvements.
Identify and resolve defects introduced or discovered during the optimization process.
6. Technical Documentation & Handover
Maintain clear documentation of technical findings, modifications, and implemented improvements.
Submit a concise technical assessment and completion report.
Provide recommendations for future system enhancements and maintenance.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Demonstrated professional experience in software development, programming, and maintaining web-based applications.
Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, with the ability to understand and work with existing application architectures.
Practical experience with Python, Flask, and Jinja-based applications , or demonstrable ability to work effectively with this technology stack.
Strong understanding of relational databases, including SQLite or SQL-based systems, query optimization, and indexing.
Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Proven expertise in code auditing, debugging, refactoring, performance optimization, and technical troubleshooting.
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks, including pytest or equivalent tools.
Understanding of web application security principles, authentication, authorization, and OWASP Top 10.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience working with ERP, CRM, finance, or enterprise business management applications.
Familiarity with Windows-based server environments and scheduled background processes.
Knowledge of Node.js or additional web development technologies.
Experience independently reviewing and upgrading existing business-critical applications.

Big Wave Digital is partnering with an early-stage AI company to find its first Frontend Engineer.
The company is building the AI intelligence platform for a large, data-rich industry. As the founding frontend hire, you'll build the interface every client engagement runs on, and create the design system the rest of the team uses to build client-facing apps.
What you'll be working on
• AI answers that stream in and link back to their exact source.
• Review queues where people approve AI outputs.
• Document upload and correction flows.
• Knowledge graph exploration.
• Dashboards on model performance.
• A design system and component library for the whole team.
This is data-heavy product UI for technical users, closer to building an analytics tool than a consumer app. Full-stack engineers whose strength is frontend are very welcome.
What we're looking for
• 3+ years of frontend engineering on B2B or data-heavy web apps.
• Experience building data-heavy product UI: dashboards, data or graph visualisations, or real-time and streaming data views.
• You've built and owned a design system or component library, not just used one.
• Production React and TypeScript.
• A portfolio or live examples of UI you've shipped – please include a link with your application.
Nice to have
• Experience as an early frontend hire at a startup, building product UI from scratch.
• Full-stack experience and comfort building API endpoints when needed.
• Next.js, Tailwind, D3 and Figma, including AI design-to-code tools such as Figma MCP.
The package
• US$150K–$200K base salary + meaningful equity (compensation is equity-heavy).
• Fully remote within the USA.
A few practical details
Applicants must be US citizens or green card holders; visa sponsorship is unavailable.
The interview process includes an initial screen, a technical review of your shipped work and design system experience, a CEO interview and a final team interview. Please note: although this role is fully remote, the interview process may include an in-person element.
Interested? Apply to Big Wave Digital ASAP.

About The Company
Software Technology Inc. develops technology solutions that help organizations improve their operations, serve customers, and adapt to changing business needs. Our teams work across software development, product delivery, and technical support to create reliable, accessible, and maintainable products. We value thoughtful problem-solving, open communication, and collaboration across disciplines. We encourage employees to share ideas, learn from one another, and contribute to an environment where quality and customer needs guide our work.
About The Role
We are seeking a Software Engineer to help design, build, test, and maintain software applications. In this role, you will work with engineers, product partners, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from understanding user and business needs to implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement. The ideal candidate is curious, dependable, and comfortable working through technical challenges in a collaborative environment. You should be able to communicate your ideas clearly, welcome constructive feedback, and balance attention to detail with practical delivery goals. This position offers opportunities to strengthen your engineering skills while contributing to products and services used by real customers.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience developing software in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, or a comparable language.
Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and common development practices.
Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git, and collaborative development workflows.
Experience writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining code, with an interest in building reliable and readable solutions.
Ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical colleagues and communicate progress, questions, and risks.
A willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and technologies as project needs evolve.
Familiarity with cloud services, databases, APIs, automated testing, or continuous integration is an asset, but not required.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain software features in alignment with product requirements and engineering standards.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, quality assurance professionals, and fellow engineers to clarify requirements and plan work.
Produce code that is readable, maintainable, secure, and appropriate for the needs of the application.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate feedback from teammates.
Investigate software defects, identify root causes, and implement solutions that help prevent recurring issues.
Contribute to technical documentation, implementation plans, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Support software releases and monitor application performance, reliability, and user experience.
Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, system quality, and engineering practices.
Follow company policies and applicable standards for privacy, security, accessibility, and responsible data handling.
Benefits
Software Technology Inc. offers a competitive compensation package and a supportive workplace designed to help employees do their best work. Depending on role eligibility and location, benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off and company holidays; retirement savings options; professional development resources; and flexible work arrangements. Employees have opportunities to collaborate with experienced colleagues, develop their technical capabilities, and contribute to meaningful projects. Specific compensation, benefits, and work arrangements will be discussed during the hiring process and may vary according to location, employment status, and applicable plan terms.
Equal Opportunity
Software Technology Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fair and inclusive hiring and employment practices. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics, in accordance with applicable laws. We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact our recruiting team to discuss your needs.

China produces about 85% of the world's cathode active material. The West needs new battery chemistries to compete, but traditional R&D can take years to deliver them. 
 
Today, we announced $45M in funding to change that. 
 
Backed by  Zone II Ventures, and Course Corrected, we're scaling our AI-powered Discovery Engine, which combines 18 years of proprietary battery data with automated labs that physically build and test new materials. Over these 18 years our platform has run more than 225 projects for more than 85 customers across the battery value chain, including nearly a dozen Fortune 500 companies, and has resulted in more than 100 battery patents.  Along the way, the platform generated an internally consistent dataset covering more than 500,000 physical cells tested at over 165 million cycles.  
 
Our technology has already helped deliver DRX, a new family of nickel- and cobalt-free cathode materials designed to reduce dependence on China. Now, we're bringing DRX toward commercialization while using AI to accelerate the next generation of breakthroughs. 
 
Led by founder and CEO Mathias Ingvarsson, COO and former Tesla manufacturing leader Steven Prast, and Chief Scientific Officer Dee Strand, we're building a faster path from battery discovery to commercial deployment. 
 
Read more in Fortune by Nick Lichtenberg. Article link in the first comment.

Clarification: On Thursday, Oct. 15, thousands of Aggie students took part in TWO major marches to downtown Greensboro:

- The first was a March to the Polls, as previously described, which went from campus to the Union Square polling location downtown on the first day of early voting in North Carolina. Students marched back to campus after voting in protest of the Guilford County Elections Board's removal of their campus early voting polling location earlier this year.

- The second was a March for Justice for Nolan Wells, the 18-year-old young man who tragically died July 4 under murky circumstances in the waters off Mississippi’s Horn Island after celebrating the Independence Day holiday. The march was organized by the A&T chapter of the NAACP, and a coalition of groups worked tirelessly to bring students together in solidarity for Nolan from across campus and the entire state. The march began at A&T’s February One monument, went downtown to the International Civil Rights Museum and returned to campus.

Incredibly, thousands of Aggies took part in *both* marches, but in the video posted here, were returning from the second march, which concluded later. In both instances, outstanding civic leadership and participation were on full display from A&T students in the best tradition of Aggies, who have been leading in important community events since the university’s establishment in 1891. 

A&T continues to be America's largest HBCU, as well as its top-rated public HBCU in Forbes and US News & World Report.
